versions.changelog:
- No code changes detected since origin/main.  
- Minor metadata update applied.  
- Repository state remains consistent with upstream.  
- No functional or behavioral changes introduced.

- Added AI product photography capabilities: generate Perfect Scene or holiday/event product photos via API.  
- Simplified onboarding: sign up or log in in one API call with no email verification required.  
- Introduced one-shot JSON flow to create buyer/seller agents with full profile and campaign details in a single OpenClaw message.  
- Removed deprecated auth endpoints (`/api/auth/verify-code`, `/api/auth/resend-code`).
Clarified in README that resend authentication/email verification is no longer needed — signup completes in a single API call with no verification step.
One-shot onboarding JSON; fix quickstart/create/SSE/messaging to match API.
Initial release — sign up, log in, create A2A buyer/seller campaigns, find brand matches, and manage B2B deal pipelines from OpenClaw.
